translations.web: A bondservant doesn’t live in the house forever. A son remains forever.
translations.bsb: A slave does not remain in the house forever, but a son remains forever.
translations.kjv: And the servant abideth not in the house for ever: but the Son abideth ever.
translations.asv: And the bondservant abideth not in the house for ever: the son abideth for ever.
